notes.title: Let's celebrate World Animal Day with Animal Week! 🥳
notes.content:
Hello Players! 👋

We are excited to announce that our game is a part of Animal Week on Steam, starting today until October 10, 2024! 😻 

https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/GamesIncubator/sale/AnimalWeek

This special event is organized to celebrate World Animal Day and aims to raise awareness about animal welfare and conservation. Here, we’ll show you a few examples of how you can take care of animals in Espresso Tycoon. 

Our mission in Sydney focuses on this the most. It takes place in an underwater café (interestingly, this is also the setting for our Prologue, which was chosen by you – our community ːsteamhappyː ).

notes.title: Espresso Tycoon - New Features Are Coming!
notes.content:
Dear Coffee Lovers,

A huge thank you for your votes in our poll on what we should develop further in our game! We are also impressed by your ideas 😀 As always, you've been incredibly helpful, and thanks to you, we've created a roadmap - and we already know what else will be coming to Espresso Tycoon!

 2 Coffee Machines - which will allow even faster coffee-making and customer service ☕️
 Alternative Campaigns in the same locations - that is, new missions with new challenges in places you already know very well 🌎

When will these new features will be added to the game?

We're presenting on the roadmap the features that were most frequently requested by our players. We still have a few things more in our plan (as you can see our game is regularly updated) and we will inform you about them, for sure! These ones are the most significant changes that are going to be added in the near future.

I've tested your latest updates. Will there be such a possibility here as well?


Of course! We appreciate very much that you help us create our game and assist us with testing. We will certainly organize tests of new features as soon as we are ready.

Will these new features be for free?
Yes, all those features we list here will be added free of charge to the basic version of Espresso Tycoon.

Why did we choose Siberia? Because it is the geographic region that we associate with very long train journeys (you know, the Trans-Siberian Railway). But you will probably notice that the atmosphere from the Orient Express can also be found here, mainly in the decorative elements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/ee8e4aa1d13cbe4891f6af4c4cf80ae0a4622ae0.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/f4bd0b6133ac68daca4ce8441b84a4dedd52a2d7.png

We also solved the problem of supplying resources to our train. It's quite a relief that, as a rule, our supplies are delivered by drones ːsteamhappyː

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/8f704c7930dda9b8f05be4ebc4ecd8abc67a8014.gif

And this is crucial because, without coal, our train will not go any further.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/b5093759006462947172032962aa648e87fee48f.gif

Running a cafe on the train is our fifth mission, and we are introducing some new features to it.

Among them is Research, which will allow you to unlock new ingredients and decoration items (after setting the right budget and category).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/3eeb014861693e8e1e873344cf45aebaa2112a57.png

We are also explaining more elements related to the Coffee Editor. One very important one is Temporal Trends. As you probably already know, each social group in our game has its own preferences. If we manage to meet all the requirements, including Temporal Trends, not only will we be sure that our customers will love a particular recipe, but they will also tip us!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/45b023cfa420ea8a1fca23ad339987cd297c6e8a.png

But it's important to note that Temporal Trends, as the name suggests, are temporal, so they will change. You need to keep track of them to stay up to date.

BTW, have you ever dreamed of having a train named after yourself? Now you can have it ːsteamhappyː

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/b33191dbfa022e496cddad77151f121b005d6e52.png

Do you like our cafe on the train? Let us know what you think!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/c7fd4a18906c54f205db408955c19d24e4d7bc6f.png

notes.title: NEW LOCATION in Espresso Tycoon - Paris
notes.content:
Bonjour Coffee Lovers!

It's time to present our next location in Espresso Tycoon...

PARIS!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/a5b7e3552e80cc0dbebed2d6d82f1976541e9526.png

We are thrilled to announce the opening of a new location for our coffee shop in the heart of Paris! Our team has been working tirelessly to bring the best coffee experience to our customers, and we are excited to share our newest addition with you.

Some of you probably expected the French café to be one of our next locations. We proposed it to you in the voting for the location of our Prologue (the underwater café in Sydney won then, but Paris also got a lot of votes).

So we got down to work!

We knew that we would have to pay a lot of attention to the architecture of the entire neighborhood.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/0d9c06d2975c3feae7467bea6646561ca265f8e0.png

The new location is situated on a charming Parisian street. The buildings represent a beautiful architectural style, with large windows that let in plenty of natural light. The interior has been designed to create a cozy atmosphere, with comfortable seating and a warm color scheme that will make you feel right at home. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/78676f875eea26d6b3b2cc930d29e77eeb24d315.png

Because these are the things that come to our minds when we think about the French café:

 great atmosphere
 a lot of interesting people
 unique design
 beautiful buildings


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/ddd449082dfc560165be6f71bc0cb552cbc851ad.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/d7afa8cf325fc39ef06fdd9cbc04f67315126831.png

Thank you for being a part of the Espresso Tycoon community, and we look forward to serving you in Paris!

Au revoir!

notes.title: Espresso Tycoon - ALL the locations from the full version of the game!

Dear Coffee Lovers,

As you already know, we're preparing 10 different locations (and missions) for you in the full version of Espresso Tycoon. You couldn't see all of them in the demo but you could have noticed that they are there 😉
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/844ab370dc79e90290d84fb16634e18c303b2311.gif

It's time to reveal what's behind these 'Not Available In Demo' parts!

1. Cape Town
You know that location from our demo. You start your journey here. This is a great place to run a coffee truck and an outdoor cafe!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/9e57f642e76916b884179efa32ddf8fdb9f67cba.png

2. New York
Run your coffee shop in a city that never sleeps and has a lot of coffee shops where you can spend time with your... Friends 😉
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/af9aa32f2f01d07e351ec068b046a6ef28521641.png

3. Sao Paolo
Take care of the customers who are always in a rush - because you're running a coffee shop in a subway station 🚇
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/3f64012dfeb2f9b8ca0fc52498cec15f0b30c744.jpg

4. Paris
Enjoy the beautiful surroundings, and exquisite flavors. Conquer the capital of fashion - with your coffee shop in Paris 🥐
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/78676f875eea26d6b3b2cc930d29e77eeb24d315.png

5. Siberia
Take a long train trip. A very long one! Don't forget to serve your customers a good cup of coffee - it will be useful for them not to get cold 🚆
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/d5f2b464278b5b5dc75404a7b378c0fe57b297b4.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/206dabc8b8368624e8c1515383509febd02c2392.png

Last but not least! Tokyo is still the world's largest city in terms of population, so you can expect to need a lot of coffee there... Will you manage to take care of so many customers?

Of course, this is just a brief description. We will be presenting each of them in detail soon!
Which one is your favorite?

notes.title: You will not believe WHAT SHE DID in that coffee shop!
notes.content:
A famous businesswoman lost a billion dollars after visiting ‘Sleepless Nights’ - the most popular coffee shop in the city!

Rachel Nelson (36) - as usual - was in a hurry. Being her thoughts at the upcoming business meeting, without unnecessary thought, she ordered coffee advertised on the stand - Special Coffee to go.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/02698dacabfcbd99e9bc17cb4dab47fb62678f86.png

There would be nothing extraordinary about it, if not for the fact that the Special Coffee she got was - indeed - special ... The coffee consisted of MAYONAISSE, TABASCO, and FISH SAUCE. 
HOW SO, you may ask? Read below!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/69f39f5a30d43563fbddc25b97868cddf2d26597.gif

It happened by an accident. 'Sleepless Nights’ adds a new coffee recipe to the menu each month. Mark Smith (32), an experienced barista, was responsible for adding Special Coffee in July.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/cb346fd1ff816e82409454bbb16c8dd58ec42f12.gif

‘I was supposed to add strawberry sauce, cinnamon sauce, and heavy cream. I didn’t notice that my little son, Steve (5), waiting for me to finish my job, changed the labels of the ingredients! - said Mark.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/4c04c0f6e919a3b0d199bf03f6a02e0221a94845.gif

‘When preparing that unfortunate coffee I was very tired... it was my last order that day’ - Mark added.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/c7a95f051e4d0092f61f5534f666ecf54983af86.gif

Do you remember the businesswoman from the first picture? 
Rachel was a regular customer of ‘Sleepless Nights’ so she didn’t expect anything out of ordinary. She decided to order Special Coffee.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/b1612ed3c1bf8796fc83e5c3e06804efcd0bb37c.gif

The most shocking fact about this whole situation is that Rachel actually ENJOYED her coffee! She even gave a positive review!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/f834dbe1538c8806302aeb499f09bd52978abd22.gif

Unfortunately, after drinking the new recipe she got stuck in the toilet for a good while. As we know from an anonymous friend of Rachel, due to that, she missed her business meeting and the deal wasn't concluded. That was a billion-dollar loss for Rachel Nelson!

To make up for this mistake, the coffee shop gave her a lifetime discount.
"I regret nothing" - said Rachel.

1. City life nearby the coffee shop

The coffee shop is not the only place where something’s going on in Espresso Tycoon. There will be also some people in the streets (and not everyone will come to your place – you have to convince customers to come). But there will be also city traffic with some cars driving (or staying, when the red light is on).

Our customers will not just stand or sit still in one pose. That would look odd. That’s why we decided to implement some different gestures and movements. They will move their legs, hands, they can stretch a bit, wave, etc.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/6af870c7b3fa894c635baa49fffdddb1b2909426.gif

3. Emotions of the characters

We focus a lot on the facial expressions of the characters. We are adding different emotions to them. That’s why you can see if they are happy, sad, or angry.

4. Adding a mess to the coffee shop

A player will have to remember to clean the coffee shop. The customers can leave the garbage – like dirty cups or used napkins. It will be also a feature connected with managing the employees. If a player will not be able to keep the place clean – the customers will not be happy. That’s why there will be a need to hire a cleaner.

notes.content:

We want our game to be as realistic as possible. That’s why we need to focus on a lot of different details. One of them is implementing the diversity between customers.

On the other hand – you can’t sell caffeine or alcohol to the kids (and you have to remember about it!), but they would love to buy some sweets or hot chocolate. Hipster can order a coffee with some special ingredients - like almond milk. That’s why you have to remember about ordering all the supplies you need.

notes.title: Dive into a hardcore management system
notes.content:
What challenges await you in Espresso Tycoon?

If you think running a coffee shop is a piece of cake, you are wrong. At least in the Espresso Tycoon game! Here, your decision-making comes from both small things, such as the pet rules for your coffee shop, and very large ones, such as opening hours. If you want to build a successful coffee business you will have to deal with all of them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/bd576f2b555015651f98a78103a4a83decef00c3.png

Let's start from the beginning

Every businessman should set himself milestones towards which he strives. Espresso Tycoon is full of such milestones. For example - before you can start selling coffee and getting rich, you need to, obviously, get your café ready. What other tasks await you?


 choosing a location for your first and each subsequent coffee shop
 decorating and furnishing your premises
 hiring, training, and taking care of the needs of different types of employees
 creating your own logo using the brand editor
 setting menus, prices and brewing your own coffee
 setting opening hours and policies, which may be different for each of your cafés
 taking care of the supply chain and ordering coffee grounds from all over the world
 analyzing customer opinions, advertising, and cooperating with popular influencers
 taking on challenges and missions that will help you earn some extra cash and fame
 expansion of your own coffee empire


Sounds like a challenge, right? Don't worry - no one is born a perfect businessman. Explore the world of Espresso Tycoon step by step. Learn, observe, and make bold decisions to soon become a successful coffee shop owner!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/cbed912b0bddfd7afa119394664de59969ae0d3e.png

Plan, decide, analyze and act!

Remember that every decision you make affects the world around your coffee shop. Your clients will be happy to share their opinion on social media, especially on the Beanstagram platform. Learn to listen to them! 

In addition, numerous tools come to your aid, such as graphs summarizing your activities so far. However, let's face it - your observations and plans are the most important here. See for yourself how rich the Espresso Tycoon world is and how deep the management system it offers. Do you think you can handle it?
